prompts.pedra: Production texture for PipaKlub, a cozy Brazilian illustrated 2D RPG. One opaque square material source filling frame edge to edge. The attached image is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its warm colors, simplified painted planes, subtle material variation. This will be warped mathematically onto exact isometric retaining walls. Generate flat FRONT ELEVATION orthographic texture; absolutely NO isometric perspective, NO wall silhouette, no top surface, no end posts or caps, no framing, no background, no ground, no vegetation, no scene, no cast shadows, no watermark or text. Clean illustrated cel style, no watercolor or photographic grain, no micro-noise. Equal brightness at opposite edges and seamless on BOTH axes, even diffuse lighting with no vignette. Subject: A straight-on seamless warm limestone retaining-wall masonry texture. Staggered courses of hand-cut irregular rectangular and polygonal stones, around 5 courses tall and 5 stones across the square. Broad cream, honey beige and muted sandy planes. Narrow warm taupe mortar, restrained chipped edges. Attractive confident shapes that read at small game scale. Similar stones to the reference but designed as a VERTICAL stone wall facing the camera square-on. No protruding boulders.
